{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "fjahr",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK on the fix, but objected to unconditional failure on unsynced index (fixed), test determinism and block count, and questioned cached index status and throwing vs partial results"
    },
    {
      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK on addressing silent LookupFilterRange failures; suggested removing tool link in description"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "asked if the author is still working on the PR"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5127611820",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "Remove the external link to the AI tool from the PR description",
      "quote": "However, I think the link to the tool can be removed and this can just say \"I found this regression while reviewing the RPC with an AI-assisted tool\".",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied 'done' in c:5194105480 and updated the description",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5194105480"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5194105480",
      "status_by_quote": "done"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4823109371",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Failing scans unconditionally when the index is behind the tip breaks scans for ranges that are already available.",
      "quote": "There we don't fail unconditionally if the index isn't synced. We only fail if we the range isn't available.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated to mirror getblockfilter and only fail when the requested range is unavailable",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5181858801"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5181858801",
      "status_by_quote": "You're right - thanks. getblockfilter does not fail merely because index is behind the tip, so it fails when the request"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4041782135",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Remove the redundant wait for the index to sync right before deleting it.",
      "quote": "This doesn't make sense, you are waiting for the index to be synced just to delete it without doing anything else.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed and stopped deleting the index in the updated test",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4458113676"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4458113676",
      "status_by_quote": "Agreed, that was pointless, so the new version does not delete the index at all."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4041798369",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "The functional test mines an excessive number of blocks.",
      "quote": "No normal functional test should require mining this many blocks.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author rewrote the test using an assumeutxo snapshot, reducing mining to 100 blocks",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4458130734"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4458130734",
      "status_by_quote": "I agree, the new test does not depend on timing anymore, it mines 100 blocks, which is the minimum needed to build the regtest snapshot chain"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4041798369",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The functional test relies on races and is non-deterministic.",
      "quote": "And we don't leave the actual testing to chance. The test either needs to work deterministically or it is of no use for us, with maybe some very rare exceptions.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author rewrote the test using an assumeutxo snapshot without peers to avoid timing dependencies",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4458130734",
        "rc:4458211167"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4458211167",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, this was the right hint and the new test does exactly that: node2 loads the regtest snapshot while it has no peers, so its filter index stays at height 199 while the active tip is at 299."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4042044214",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Index readiness checked before the scan begins may become outdated by the end of a long scan, leading to misclassified errors.",
      "quote": "This status may be outdated at the end of a long scan.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author removed the cached index_ready flag and checks index state at failure time via GetSummary()",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4458224506"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4458224506",
      "status_by_quote": "Agreed. The flag is gone. The state of the index is now read at the moment the lookup fails, with GetSummary()"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4042053714",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Why throw an error when a filter range is unavailable instead of returning a partial result?",
      "quote": "Why throw here instead of returning a partial result?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained why returning partial results would be problematic and asked reviewer to clarify preference",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4458244866"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4458244866",
      "status_by_quote": "I thought about it and chose the error for these reasons: 1. \"completed\" is documented as \"true if the scan was not aborted\"."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:5127611820",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Fixes silent ignore of LookupFilterRange failures",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5241815385",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Concept ACK on handling this but the test needs a lot of work",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "test/functional/rpc_scanblocks.py"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "notes": "The author pushed updated tests and code addressing all open items from fjahr, explaining the rationale for throwing errors instead of returning partial results. Awaiting fjahr's review of the changes.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "fjahr to review author's replies and updated test suite",
      "id": "rc:4458099319"
    }
  ]
}
